props.gloss_en: the measure for carrying out waste water to the public domain is a quarter-log
R' Yirmeya: waste waters are fit for kneading clay
the baraita: [the measure for carrying out] clay is enough to make the mouth of a crucible
this [the baraita's clay measure] is of clay already kneaded
that [the waste water for kneading] is of clay not yet kneaded
for a person does not trouble to knead clay to make the mouth of a crucible

supports.gloss_en: שופכין למאי חזו? -- לגבל בהן את הטיט: waste water is fit for kneading clay, which is why carrying it out is measured

objections.gloss_en: והתניא: טיט כדי לעשות בהן פי כור -- a baraita measures clay by what makes the mouth of a crucible

answered_by.gloss_en: לא קשיא: הא דמיגבל, הא דלא מיגבל -- the baraita speaks of kneaded clay, R' Yirmeya of clay not yet kneaded, since no one troubles to knead clay for a crucible's mouth (= p_tit_okimta_megubal, p_shofchin_okimta_lo_megubal, p_ein_adam_toreach)
